{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Sentinel value (-1) in customer_age:", (sales_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check for duplicates
print("Duplicate order_id:", sales_df['order_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check status values
print("Status value counts:\n", sales_df['status'].value_counts())

# Check customer_segment value counts
print("Customer segment value counts:\n", sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check converted value counts
print("Converted value counts:\n", sales_df['converted'].value_counts())"}
